description: This file contains unit tests for the RingRangeCollection class, covering its containment, intersection, and difference functionalities, primarily in the context of ring ranges and their wrap-around behavior.

classes.name: RingRangeCollectionTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for verifying the behavior of the RingRangeCollection class, including containment, intersection, difference, and wrap-around logic.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Tests whether the collection correctly reports containment of a point.

methods.name: Intersects
methods.description: Verifies that each range within a collection intersects with the collection itself.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Checks the correct calculation of differences between rings and updates, including intersection validations.

methods.name: ContainsTest
methods.description: Additional containment check to ensure the collection's Contains method behaves as expected.

methods.name: ContainsWrappedTest
methods.description: Tests containment logic with ranges that wrap around the ring's start/end boundaries, including edge cases.
